summary: Thousand taps the fingertips of a bent hand (M shape) into the other palm, from the Roman numeral M for 1000.
handshape: Bent hand or M onto a flat palm
steps: Hold your non-dominant hand flat, palm facing sideways or up.
Bend your dominant hand and tap the fingertips into the palm.
Put a number before it for two thousand, three thousand, and so on.
mistakes: Tapping with a flat hand. The fingers are bent.
